subject: Five-Year Affordable Housing Action Plan
overview: The board presented its draft five-year action plan and local housing data to the public for review and comment. Key announcements included a $300,000 grant opportunity for housing developers and a roadmap for expanding local housing assistance and revenue sources.

items.title: Introduction and Participant Survey
items.summary: Board members introduced themselves and requested that attendees complete a survey regarding their housing status to assist in local data collection.

items.title: Trust History and Timeline
items.summary: The board reviewed the 2024 establishment of the Trust and the sequence of planning efforts, including the Housing Production Plan and Comprehensive Plan, that informed the current draft.

items.title: Housing Construction Grants
items.summary: Officials announced that $300,000 is available for housing construction grants, with applications for the current RFP due in August.

items.title: Housing Data and Affordability Analysis
items.summary: Roberta Cameron presented data highlighting significant growth in the young adult population, an aging housing stock, and high rates of housing cost burden among seniors.

items.title: Draft Five-Year Action Plan Presentation
items.summary: Penelope Taylor outlined the plan's goals to create and preserve community housing through partnerships with mission-driven organizations and the Medford Housing Authority.

items.title: Potential Revenue Sources
items.summary: The board explored future funding options for the Trust, such as real estate transfer fees, linkage payments, and payments in lieu of taxes (PILOT) from large institutional employers.

items.title: Public Comment and Next Steps
items.summary: Residents shared concerns regarding systemic barriers, credit score discrimination, and housing authority escrow accounts, while the board noted that public comments remain open until August 7.
